+/**
+ * Represents immutable POSIX byte-path spellings, including invalid UTF-8.
+ * Slash is the only separator. Empty values, dots, repeated separators and
+ * trailing separators are preserved. These values do not establish filesystem
+ * validity or confinement, and do not provide Windows-native path semantics.
+ *
+ * @stability unstable
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+import * as Bytes from "./Bytes.ts"
+import * as Data from "./Data.ts"
+import * as Equal from "./Equal.ts"
+import * as Hash from "./Hash.ts"
+import * as order from "./Order.ts"
+import { type Pipeable, pipeArguments } from "./Pipeable.ts"
+import * as Result from "./Result.ts"
+
+const TypeId = "~effect/BytePath"
+
+/**
+ * An immutable, opaque POSIX byte-path spelling with no NUL bytes.
+ *
+ * @stability unstable
+ * @category models
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+export interface BytePath extends Equal.Equal, Pipeable {
+  readonly [TypeId]: typeof TypeId
+}
+
+/**
+ * Error returned when path construction or text conversion fails.
+ *
+ * **Details**
+ *
+ * Out-of-bounds resizable-buffer views use `InvalidInput`. Error precedence
+ * for inputs violating multiple rules is unspecified.
+ *
+ * @stability unstable
+ * @category errors
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+export class BytePathError extends Data.TaggedError("BytePathError")<{
+  readonly reason: "NulByte" | "InvalidUtf16" | "InvalidUtf8" | "SharedBuffer" | "DetachedBuffer" | "InvalidInput"
+  readonly message: string
+}> {}
+
+const byteViewErrors = {
+  InvalidInput: { reason: "InvalidInput", message: "Expected a Uint8Array" },
+  SharedBuffer: { reason: "SharedBuffer", message: "SharedArrayBuffer-backed paths are not supported" },
+  DetachedBuffer: { reason: "DetachedBuffer", message: "The input buffer is detached" },
+  OutOfBounds: { reason: "InvalidInput", message: "The Uint8Array view is out of bounds or cannot be copied" }
+} as const
+
+const registry = new WeakMap<object, Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>>()
+
+const encoder = new TextEncoder()
+const decoder = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true, ignoreBOM: true })
+
+const bytes = (path: BytePath): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> => {
+  const value = registry.get(path)
+  if (value === undefined) throw new TypeError("Expected a genuine BytePath")
+  return value
+}
+
+const Proto: BytePath = Object.freeze({
+  [TypeId]: TypeId,
+  [Equal.symbol](this: BytePath, that: unknown): boolean {
+    return isBytePath(that) && Bytes.Equivalence(bytes(this), bytes(that))
+  },
+  [Hash.symbol](this: BytePath): number {
+    return Hash.array(bytes(this))
+  },
+  pipe(this: BytePath) {
+    return pipeArguments(this, arguments)
+  }
+})
+
+const make = (value: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>): BytePath => {
+  const path = Object.freeze(Object.create(Proto))
+  registry.set(path, value)
+  return path
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks whether a value was constructed by this copy of the BytePath module.
+ *
+ * @stability unstable
+ * @category guards
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+export const isBytePath = (input: unknown): input is BytePath =>
+  typeof input === "object" && input !== null && registry.has(input)
+
+/**
+ * Creates a path by immediately copying an attached, non-shared Uint8Array.
+ *
+ * **Details**
+ *
+ * Accepts same-realm Uint8Arrays, including empty arrays, subviews and Node
+ * Buffers. Rejects NUL bytes, shared or detached buffers, out-of-bounds views
+ * and non-Uint8Array input. Shadowed properties and custom iterators are ignored.
+ *
+ * **Example** (Preserving a non-UTF-8 filename)
+ *
+ * ```ts import.meta.vitest
+ * import { BytePath, Result } from "effect"
+ *
+ * const path = Result.getOrThrow(BytePath.fromBytes(new Uint8Array([47, 255])))
+ *
+ * Array.from(BytePath.toBytes(path)) // => [47, 255]
+ * Result.isFailure(BytePath.toString(path)) // => true
+ * ```
+ *
+ * @see {@link toBytes} for exporting a copy of the path bytes
+ * @stability unstable
+ * @category constructors
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+export const fromBytes = (input: Uint8Array): Result.Result<BytePath, BytePathError> => {
+  if (!ArrayBuffer.isView(input) || !(input instanceof Uint8Array)) {
+    return Result.fail(new BytePathError(byteViewErrors.InvalidInput))
+  }
+  return Result.gen(function*() {
+    const length = yield* Result.mapError(
+      Bytes.byteLength(input),
+      (error) => new BytePathError(byteViewErrors[error.reason])
+    )
+    const copy = yield* Result.try({
+      try: () => {
+        const buffer = Reflect.get(Uint8Array.prototype, "buffer", input)
+        const offset: number = Reflect.get(Uint8Array.prototype, "byteOffset", input)
+        const copy = new Uint8Array(length)
+        copy.set(new Uint8Array(buffer, offset, length))
+        return copy
+      },
+      catch: () => new BytePathError(byteViewErrors.OutOfBounds)
+    })
+    if (copy.includes(0)) {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new BytePathError({ reason: "NulByte", message: "BytePath cannot contain NUL bytes" }))
+    }
+    return make(copy)
+  })
+}
+
+/**
+ * Creates a path from well-formed UTF-16 text, preserving BOMs and Unicode
+ * spelling without normalization. Rejects NUL and unpaired surrogates.
+ *
+ * @see {@link toString} for lossless UTF-8 decoding
+ * @stability unstable
+ * @category constructors
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+export const fromString = (input: string): Result.Result<BytePath, BytePathError> => {
+  if (typeof input !== "string") {
+    return Result.fail(new BytePathError({ reason: "InvalidInput", message: "Expected a string" }))
+  }
+  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
+    const code = input.charCodeAt(i)
+    if (code === 0) {
+      return Result.fail(new BytePathError({ reason: "NulByte", message: "BytePath cannot contain NUL bytes" }))
+    }
+    if (code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdbff) {
+      const next = input.charCodeAt(++i)
+      if (!(next >= 0xdc00 && next <= 0xdfff)) {
+        return Result.fail(new BytePathError({ reason: "InvalidUtf16", message: "Unpaired UTF-16 surrogate" }))
+      }
+    } else if (code >= 0xdc00 && code <= 0xdfff) {
+      return Result.fail(new BytePathError({ reason: "InvalidUtf16", message: "Unpaired UTF-16 surrogate" }))
+    }
+  }
+  return Result.succeed(make(encoder.encode(input)))
+}
+
+/**
+ * Returns a fresh mutable copy of the path bytes.
+ *
+ * @see {@link fromBytes} for validating and copying input bytes
+ * @stability unstable
+ * @category destructors
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+export const toBytes = (path: BytePath): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> => bytes(path).slice()
+
+/**
+ * Returns the exact number of path bytes without copying them.
+ *
+ * @stability unstable
+ * @category getters
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+export const byteLength = (path: BytePath): number => bytes(path).byteLength
+
+/**
+ * Decodes a path as strict UTF-8, preserving a leading BOM. Returns
+ * `InvalidUtf8` when the bytes have no lossless text representation.
+ *
+ * @see {@link fromString} for constructing paths from well-formed text
+ * @stability unstable
+ * @category destructors
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+export const toString = (path: BytePath): Result.Result<string, BytePathError> => {
+  const value = bytes(path)
+  return Result.try({
+    try: () => decoder.decode(value),
+    catch: () => new BytePathError({ reason: "InvalidUtf8", message: "BytePath contains invalid UTF-8" })
+  })
+}
+
+/**
+ * The empty byte-path spelling, which filesystem operations may reject.
+ *
+ * @stability unstable
+ * @category constants
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+export const empty: BytePath = make(new Uint8Array(0))
+
+/**
+ * Checks whether the first byte is a slash, without resolving the path.
+ *
+ * @stability unstable
+ * @category predicates
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+export const isAbsolute = (path: BytePath): boolean => bytes(path)[0] === 0x2f
+
+/**
+ * Orders paths lexicographically by unsigned bytes, with shorter equal
+ * prefixes first.
+ *
+ * @stability unstable
+ * @category instances
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+export const Order: order.Order<BytePath> = order.mapInput(Bytes.Order, bytes)

+export class ByteViewError extends Data.TaggedError("ByteViewError")<{
+  readonly reason: "InvalidInput" | "SharedBuffer" | "DetachedBuffer" | "OutOfBounds"
+}> {}
+
+/**
+ * Returns the actual byte length of an attached, non-shared `Uint8Array` view.
+ *
+ * **Details**
+ *
+ * Accepts same-realm Uint8Arrays, including empty arrays, subviews and Node
+ * Buffers. Built-in getters ignore shadowed instance properties and custom
+ * iterators. The input bytes are neither copied nor modified.
+ *
+ * **Gotchas**
+ *
+ * Shared or detached buffers and out-of-bounds resizable-buffer views fail.
+ * A successful check does not prevent the buffer from being resized or
+ * detached later; validate again when using a view after external code runs.
+ *
+ * **Example** (Measuring a view with a shadowed length)
+ *
+ * ```ts import.meta.vitest
+ * import { Bytes, Result } from "effect"
+ *
+ * const bytes = new Uint8Array([10, 20, 30, 40])
+ * Object.defineProperty(bytes, "length", { value: 99 })
+ *
+ * Result.getOrThrow(Bytes.byteLength(bytes)) // => 4
+ * Result.getOrThrow(Bytes.byteLength(bytes.subarray(1, 3))) // => 2
+ * ```
+ *
+ * @see {@link ByteViewError} for invalid-view reasons
+ * @stability unstable
+ * @category getters
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+export const byteLength = (input: unknown): Result.Result<number, ByteViewError> => {
+  let reason: ByteViewError["reason"] = "InvalidInput"
+  return Result.flatMap(
+    Result.try({
+      try: () => {
+        if (!(input instanceof Uint8Array)) return Result.fail(new ByteViewError({ reason }))
+        const buffer = Reflect.get(Uint8Array.prototype, "buffer", input)
+        reason = "SharedBuffer"
+        Reflect.get(ArrayBuffer.prototype, "byteLength", buffer)
+        reason = "DetachedBuffer"
+        const attached = new Uint8Array(buffer, 0, 0)
+        reason = "OutOfBounds"
+        // A zero-byte set validates view bounds even when byteLength would report zero.
+        Uint8Array.prototype.set.call(input, attached)
+        const length: number = Reflect.get(Uint8Array.prototype, "byteLength", input)
+        return Result.succeed(length)
+      },
+      catch: () => new ByteViewError({ reason })
+    }),
+    identity
+  )
+}

+/**
+ * Exact signed nanoseconds since the Unix/POSIX epoch.
+ *
+ * **Details**
+ *
+ * Accepts every `bigint`, including values outside the range of `DateTime`.
+ * This type is separate from the millisecond-based `Utc` and `Zoned` types.
+ * Use `Schema.UnixNano` to validate unknown input.
+ *
+ * @see {@link unixNanoFromNanoseconds} for constructing exact instants
+ * @see {@link unixNanoToDateTime} for conversion to millisecond-based UTC values
+ * @stability experimental
+ * @category models
+ * @since 4.0.7
+ */
+export type UnixNano = Brand.Branded<bigint, "UnixNano">
+
+/**
+ * Tagged error returned when a Unix nanosecond conversion fails.
+ *
+ * **Details**
+ *
+ * Checked conversions return this error in `Result`. Input validation comes
+ * before range and precision checks. Unexpected exceptions propagate.
+ * The error retains only the reason, direction, and unit.
+ * Use `Schema.UnixNanoConversionError` to decode or encode these errors.
+ *
+ * @stability experimental
+ * @category errors
+ * @since 4.0.7
+ */
+export class UnixNanoConversionError extends Data.TaggedError("ConversionError")<UnixNano.ConversionReason> {}
+
+/**
+ * Brands exact `bigint` nanoseconds without scaling or range checks.
+ *
+ * **Gotchas**
+ *
+ * Throws `TypeError` if an untyped caller supplies a non-bigint value.
+ *
+ * @stability experimental
+ * @category constructors
+ * @since 4.0.7
+ */
+export const unixNanoFromNanoseconds = (value: bigint): UnixNano => {
+  if (typeof value !== "bigint") throw new TypeError("Expected bigint nanoseconds")
+  return value as UnixNano
+}
+
+/**
+ * Returns the exact signed `bigint` nanoseconds.
+ *
+ * @stability experimental
+ * @category destructors
+ * @since 4.0.7
+ */
+export const unixNanoToNanoseconds = (value: UnixNano): bigint => value
+
+/**
+ * Converts seconds to exact epoch nanoseconds by default.
+ *
+ * **Details**
+ *
+ * Multiplies `bigint` input by `1000000000n`. Interprets finite number input using
+ * its canonical decimal spelling, including exponent notation, with integer
+ * scaling. Rejects `NaN` and infinities. Negative values denote pre-epoch
+ * instants, and negative zero becomes zero. No string coercion occurs.
+ *
+ * **Gotchas**
+ *
+ * Exact conversion rejects subnanosecond remainders. Explicit `"truncate"`
+ * precision discards them toward zero. Digits already lost in a JavaScript
+ * number cannot be recovered.
+ *
+ * @stability experimental
+ * @category converting
+ * @since 4.0.7
+ */
+export const unixNanoFromSeconds = (
+  value: bigint | number,
+  options?: UnixNano.ConversionOptions
+): Result.Result<UnixNano, UnixNanoConversionError> => fromScaled(value, 9, "seconds", options)
+
+/**
+ * Converts milliseconds to exact epoch nanoseconds by default.
+ *
+ * **Details**
+ *
+ * Multiplies `bigint` input by `1000000n`. Interprets finite number input using
+ * its canonical decimal spelling, including exponent notation, with integer
+ * scaling. Rejects `NaN` and infinities. Negative values denote pre-epoch
+ * instants, and negative zero becomes zero. No string coercion occurs.
+ *
+ * **Gotchas**
+ *
+ * Exact conversion rejects subnanosecond remainders. Explicit `"truncate"`
+ * precision discards them toward zero. Digits already lost in a JavaScript
+ * number cannot be recovered.
+ *
+ * @stability experimental
+ * @category converting
+ * @since 4.0.7
+ */
+export const unixNanoFromMilliseconds = (
+  value: bigint | number,
+  options?: UnixNano.ConversionOptions
+): Result.Result<UnixNano, UnixNanoConversionError> => fromScaled(value, 6, "milliseconds", options)
+
+/**
+ * Snapshots a valid `Date` once and converts its integer epoch milliseconds.
+ *
+ * **Gotchas**
+ *
+ * An invalid `Date` returns `InvalidInput`. Subsequent `Date` mutations cannot
+ * change the returned value.
+ *
+ * @stability experimental
+ * @category converting
+ * @since 4.0.7
+ */
+export const unixNanoFromDate = (value: Date): Result.Result<UnixNano, UnixNanoConversionError> => {
+  if (!Predicate.isDate(value)) {
+    return Result.fail(new UnixNanoConversionError({ reason: "InvalidInput", direction: "toUnixNano", unit: "Date" }))
+  }
+  return fromInstantMilliseconds(value.getTime(), "Date")
+}
+
+/**
+ * Converts a UTC or zoned `DateTime` using its instant milliseconds.
+ *
+ * **Details**
+ *
+ * Uses instant milliseconds regardless of zone. Rejects malformed inputs and
+ * milliseconds that are non-finite, fractional, or outside the inclusive range
+ * -8640000000000000 through 8640000000000000 with `InvalidInput`.
+ *
+ * @stability experimental
+ * @category converting
+ * @since 4.0.7
+ */
+export const unixNanoFromDateTime = (value: DateTime): Result.Result<UnixNano, UnixNanoConversionError> => {
+  if (!Internal.isDateTime(value) || (!Internal.isUtc(value) && !Internal.isZoned(value))) {
+    return Result.fail(
+      new UnixNanoConversionError({ reason: "InvalidInput", direction: "toUnixNano", unit: "DateTime" })
+    )
+  }
+  return fromInstantMilliseconds(Internal.toEpochMillis(value), "DateTime")
+}
+
+/**
+ * Converts epoch nanoseconds to a `Date` with exact millisecond precision by default.
+ *
+ * **Details**
+ *
+ * Checks the original nanoseconds against the inclusive range
+ * `-8640000000000000000000n` through `8640000000000000000000n` before
+ * precision handling. Exact conversion requires divisibility by `1000000n`.
+ * Explicit `"truncate"` divides toward zero, then converts the safe integer
+ * milliseconds to a number. Each successful call returns a fresh `Date`.
+ *
+ * **Gotchas**
+ *
+ * A value one nanosecond outside either boundary returns `OutOfRange`, even
+ * when truncation would bring it within range. For `-1n`, exact conversion
+ * returns `PrecisionLoss`. `"truncate"` produces epoch millisecond zero.
+ *
+ * **Example** (Converting an instant before the epoch)
+ *
+ * ```ts import.meta.vitest
+ * import { DateTime, Result } from "effect"
+ *
+ * const instant = DateTime.unixNanoFromNanoseconds(-1n)
+ * Result.getOrThrow(DateTime.unixNanoToDate(instant, { precision: "truncate" })).getTime() // => 0
+ * ```
+ *
+ * @stability experimental
+ * @category converting
+ * @since 4.0.7
+ */
+export const unixNanoToDate = (
+  value: UnixNano,
+  options?: UnixNano.ConversionOptions
+): Result.Result<Date, UnixNanoConversionError> =>
+  Result.map(toMilliseconds(value, "Date", options), (milliseconds) => new Date(milliseconds))
+
+/**
+ * Converts epoch nanoseconds to a `Utc` with exact millisecond precision by default.
+ *
+ * **Details**
+ *
+ * Checks the original nanoseconds against the inclusive range
+ * `-8640000000000000000000n` through `8640000000000000000000n` before
+ * precision handling. Exact conversion requires divisibility by `1000000n`.
+ * Explicit `"truncate"` divides toward zero, then converts the safe integer
+ * milliseconds to a number.
+ *
+ * **Gotchas**
+ *
+ * A value one nanosecond outside either boundary returns `OutOfRange`, even
+ * when truncation would bring it within range. For `-1n`, exact conversion
+ * returns `PrecisionLoss`. `"truncate"` produces epoch millisecond zero.
+ *
+ * @stability experimental
+ * @category converting
+ * @since 4.0.7
+ */
+export const unixNanoToDateTime = (
+  value: UnixNano,
+  options?: UnixNano.ConversionOptions
+): Result.Result<Utc, UnixNanoConversionError> =>
+  Result.map(toMilliseconds(value, "DateTime", options), (milliseconds) => Internal.makeUnsafe(milliseconds))
+
+/**
+ * Types used by Unix nanosecond conversions.
+ *
+ * @stability experimental
+ * @since 4.0.7
+ */
+export declare namespace UnixNano {
+  /**
+   * Conversion precision options. The default `"exact"` rejects any remainder.
+   * `"truncate"` discards the remainder toward zero.
+   *
+   * @since 4.0.7
+   */
+  export interface ConversionOptions {
+    readonly precision?: "exact" | "truncate"
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * A conversion failure's reason, direction, and unit.
+   *
+   * @since 4.0.7
+   */
+  export interface ConversionReason {
+    readonly reason: "InvalidInput" | "OutOfRange" | "PrecisionLoss"
+    readonly direction: "toUnixNano" | "fromUnixNano"
+    readonly unit: "nanoseconds" | "seconds" | "milliseconds" | "Date" | "DateTime"
+  }
+}
+
+const NANOS_PER_MILLS = BigInt("1000000")
+const MAX_NANOS = BigInt("8640000000000000000000")
+
+const fromScaled = (
+  value: bigint | number,
+  scale: number,
+  unit: "seconds" | "milliseconds",
+  options?: UnixNano.ConversionOptions
+): Result.Result<UnixNano, UnixNanoConversionError> => {
+  if (typeof value !== "bigint" && (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value))) {
+    return Result.fail(new UnixNanoConversionError({ reason: "InvalidInput", direction: "toUnixNano", unit }))
+  }
+
+  if (typeof value === "bigint") {
+    return Result.succeed(unixNanoFromNanoseconds(value * BigInt("10") ** BigInt(scale)))
+  }
+
+  // Number spelling is the contract, rather than its binary floating-point expansion.
+  const [coefficient, exponent = "0"] = String(value).toLowerCase().split("e")
+  const [whole, fraction = ""] = coefficient.split(".")
+  const integer = BigInt(whole + fraction)
+  const power = scale + Number(exponent) - fraction.length
+
+  if (power >= 0) return Result.succeed(unixNanoFromNanoseconds(integer * BigInt("10") ** BigInt(power)))
+
+  const divisor = BigInt("10") ** BigInt(-power)
+
+  if (options?.precision !== "truncate" && integer % divisor !== BigInt("0")) {
+    return Result.fail(new UnixNanoConversionError({ reason: "PrecisionLoss", direction: "toUnixNano", unit }))
+  }
+
+  return Result.succeed(unixNanoFromNanoseconds(integer / divisor))
+}
+
+const fromInstantMilliseconds = (
+  milliseconds: number,
+  unit: "Date" | "DateTime"
+): Result.Result<UnixNano, UnixNanoConversionError> => {
+  if (!Number.isInteger(milliseconds) || Math.abs(milliseconds) > 8_640_000_000_000_000) {
+    return Result.fail(new UnixNanoConversionError({ reason: "InvalidInput", direction: "toUnixNano", unit }))
+  }
+
+  return Result.succeed(unixNanoFromNanoseconds(BigInt(milliseconds) * NANOS_PER_MILLS))
+}
+
+const toMilliseconds = (
+  value: UnixNano,
+  unit: "Date" | "DateTime",
+  options?: UnixNano.ConversionOptions
+): Result.Result<number, UnixNanoConversionError> => {
+  if (typeof value !== "bigint") {
+    return Result.fail(new UnixNanoConversionError({ reason: "InvalidInput", direction: "fromUnixNano", unit }))
+  }
+
+  const nanoseconds = value
+  if (nanoseconds < -MAX_NANOS || nanoseconds > MAX_NANOS) {
+    return Result.fail(new UnixNanoConversionError({ reason: "OutOfRange", direction: "fromUnixNano", unit }))
+  }
+
+  if (options?.precision !== "truncate" && nanoseconds % NANOS_PER_MILLS !== BigInt("0")) {
+    return Result.fail(new UnixNanoConversionError({ reason: "PrecisionLoss", direction: "fromUnixNano", unit }))
+  }
+
+  return Result.succeed(Number(nanoseconds / NANOS_PER_MILLS))
+}

+/**
+ * Constructs an empty filesystem with finite limits.
+ *
+ * **Details**
+ *
+ * The returned Owner has no Scope requirement. Its `authorize` method acquires a caller in the current Scope.
+ * Credentials require an explicit uid and gid. uid zero has no implicit privilege, and construction creates
+ * only the root directory. Construction captures the current Clock, using Effect's default clock unless
+ * one is provided. All four root timestamps use one sample of that clock.
+ *
+ * **Example** (Writing through a scoped caller)
+ *
+ * ```ts import.meta.vitest
+ * import { Effect } from "effect"
+ * import { VirtualFileSystem } from "effect/virtual-file-system"
+ *
+ * const program = Effect.scoped(Effect.gen(function*() {
+ *   const owner = yield* VirtualFileSystem.make()
+ *   const caller = yield* owner.authorize({ credentials: { uid: 0, gid: 0 } })
+ *   yield* caller.writeFile("/hello.txt", new TextEncoder().encode("Hello"))
+ *   return new TextDecoder().decode(yield* caller.readFile("/hello.txt"))
+ * }))
+ *
+ * await Effect.runPromise(program) // => "Hello"
+ * ```
+ *
+ * @stability experimental
+ * @category constructors
+ * @since 4.1.0
+ */
+export const make: (
+  configuration?: M.Configuration
+) => Effect.Effect<M.Owner, M.VirtualFileSystemError> = Effect.fnUntraced(
+  function*(configuration) {
+    const clock = yield* Clock.Clock
+    return yield* Effect.suspend(() =>
+      Result.match(
+        Result.try(() =>
+          Result.gen(function*() {
+            yield* E.checkOptionsResult(configuration, ["limits", "root", "accessTime", "groupInheritance"], "make")
+            const groupInheritance = yield* E.groupInheritanceResult(configuration?.groupInheritance, "make")
+            const accessTime = yield* E.accessTimeResult(configuration?.accessTime, "make")
+            const limits = yield* R.configureResult(configuration?.limits)
+            yield* E.checkOptionsResult(configuration?.root, ["uid", "gid", "mode"], "make")
+            const root = {
+              uid: yield* E.identityResult(configuration?.root?.uid ?? 0, "make", "uid"),
+              gid: yield* E.identityResult(configuration?.root?.gid ?? 0, "make", "gid"),
+              mode: yield* E.modeResult(configuration?.root?.mode ?? DEFAULT_ROOT_MODE, "make")
+            }
+            return yield* ownerFor(
+              new E.Engine(new R.Runtime(limits, clock), root, undefined, accessTime, groupInheritance)
+            )
+          })
+        ),
+        { onFailure: R.failure, onSuccess: Effect.fromResult }
+      )
+    )
+  }

+ * and directory aliases. Dangling symlinks and cyclic symlink targets remain valid.

+ * identity tokens and a distinct instance number. Every mutable input record is copied before the next pull,
+ * and producer finalization completes before Owner delivery. Producer failures and cleanup defects retain
+ * their Effect Cause. Construction captures the current Clock, using Effect's default clock unless one
+ * is provided.

+ * import { VirtualFileSystem } from "effect/virtual-file-system"
+ *
+ * const snapshot = await Effect.runPromise(
+ *   Effect.scoped(Effect.gen(function*() {
+ *     const owner = yield* VirtualFileSystem.make()
+ *     const caller = yield* owner.authorize({ credentials: { uid: 0, gid: 0 } })

+ *   const owner = yield* VirtualFileSystem.restore(snapshot)

+ * using Effect's default clock unless one is provided.

+ * import { Effect } from "effect"
+ * import { VirtualFileSystem } from "effect/virtual-file-system"

+ * const files = VirtualFileSystem.layer({ caller: { credentials: { uid: 0, gid: 0 } } })

+ *   const caller = yield* VirtualFileSystem.VirtualFileSystem

+            return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "recursive", reason: "malformed" }))
+          }
+        }
+        if (operation !== "createFile") {
+          const times = yield* E.checkOptionsResult(object?.preserveTimes, timeFields, operation)
+          if (object?.preserveTimes !== undefined && (!isUnixNano(times?.atime) || !isUnixNano(times?.mtime))) {
+            return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "preserveTimes", reason: "malformed" }))
+          }
+        }
+        yield* condition(object?.conditions, operation, true)
+      })),
+    Match.whenOr("makeSymlink", "makeHardLink", () => Result.map(condition(options, operation, true), () => undefined)),
+    Match.whenOr("unlink", "removeDirectory", () =>
+      Result.gen(function*() {
+        const fields = yield* condition(options, operation)
+        if (fields?.expected === "absent") {
+          return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "expected", reason: "malformed" }))
+        }
+      })),
+    Match.when("rename", () =>
+      Result.gen(function*() {
+        const object = yield* E.checkOptionsResult(options, optionFields.rename, operation)
+        const source = yield* condition(object?.source, operation)
+        if (source?.expected === "absent") {
+          return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "expected", reason: "malformed" }))
+        }
+        yield* condition(object?.destination, operation)
+      })),
+    Match.when("setAttributes", () =>
+      Result.gen(function*() {
+        const object = yield* E.checkOptionsResult(options, optionFields.setAttributes, operation)
+        const followFinalSymlink = object?.followFinalSymlink
+        if (followFinalSymlink !== undefined && !isBoolean(followFinalSymlink)) {
+          return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "followFinalSymlink", reason: "malformed" }))
+        }
+      })),
+    Match.when(
+      "truncate",
+      () => Result.map(E.checkOptionsResult(options, optionFields.truncate, operation), () => undefined)
+    ),
+    Match.whenOr("publishCopiedFile", "publishCopiedSymlink", (operation) =>
+      Result.gen(function*() {
+        const object = yield* E.checkOptionsResult(options, optionFields[operation], operation)
+        const overwrite = object?.overwrite
+        if (overwrite !== undefined && !isBoolean(overwrite)) {
+          return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "overwrite", reason: "malformed" }))
+        }
+        if (object?.mode !== undefined) yield* E.modeResult(object.mode, operation)
+        yield* condition(object?.destination, operation)
+        const times = yield* E.checkOptionsResult(object?.preserveTimes, timeFields, operation)
+        if (object?.preserveTimes !== undefined && (!isUnixNano(times?.atime) || !isUnixNano(times?.mtime))) {
+          return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "preserveTimes", reason: "malformed" }))
+        }
+      })),
+    Match.orElse((operation: never) =>
+      Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "operation", reason: "malformed" }))
+    )
+  )

+// Transaction helpers

+/** @internal */
+export const reserveFile = (tx: E.Transaction, amount: bigint): Result.Result<number, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    if (amount > tx.engine.runtime.limits.fileBytes) {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.LimitExceeded({ operation: tx.operation, domain: "file", stage: "publication" }))
+    }
+    if (amount > BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation: tx.operation, field: "length", reason: "range" }))
+    }
+    yield* tx.reserveResult(amount)
+    return Number(amount)
+  })

+/** @internal */
+export const lookup = (tx: E.Transaction, target: M.Target): Result.Result<M.ObjectReference, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.map(tx.targetResult(target), (route) => tx.engine.reference(route.object.id))

+/** @internal */
+export const stat = (tx: E.Transaction, target: M.Target): Result.Result<M.ObjectObservation, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.map(tx.objectResult(target), (node) => tx.observation(node))

+/** @internal */
+export const linkStat = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  target: M.EntryTarget
+): Result.Result<M.ObjectObservation, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.map(tx.targetResult(target, false), (route) => tx.observation(route.object))

+/** @internal */
+export const access = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  target: M.Target,
+  options?: M.AccessOptions
+): Result.Result<void, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    yield* validate("access", options)
+    const { object: node } = yield* tx.targetResult(target)
+    yield* tx.requireResult(
+      node,
+      (options?.read ? E.READ_PERMISSION : 0) | (options?.write ? E.WRITE_PERMISSION : 0) |
+        (options?.execute ? E.EXECUTE_PERMISSION : 0)
+    )
+  })
+
+/** @internal */
+export const observeEntry = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  address: M.EntryAddress
+): Result.Result<M.EntryObservation, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    const slot = yield* tx.slotResult(address)
+    yield* tx.reserveResult(BigInt(BytePath.byteLength(slot.name)))
+    return yield* tx.entryResult(slot.parent, slot.name, slot.binding)
+  })
+
+/** @internal */
+export const observeRouteParent = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  input: M.Path
+): Result.Result<Option.Option<M.PresentEntry>, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    const route = yield* tx.targetResult(input, false)
+    if (route.object.id === tx.caller.policy.root) return Option.none()
+    let parent = route.parent
+    let binding = route.binding
+    if (parent === undefined || binding === undefined) {
+      if (route.object.kind !== "directory" || route.object.parent === undefined) {
+        return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidResource({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "wrongKind" }))
+      }
+      parent = yield* tx.directoryResult(route.object.parent)
+      yield* tx.requireResult(parent, E.EXECUTE_PERMISSION)
+      yield* tx.visitResult()
+      binding = yield* tx.findBindingResult(parent, route.object.id)
+    }
+    if (binding === undefined) {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.NotFound({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "missingRoute" }))
+    }
+    yield* tx.reserveResult(BigInt(BytePath.byteLength(binding.name)))
+    const entry = yield* tx.entryResult(parent, binding.name, binding)
+    return entry.state === "present" ? Option.some(entry) : Option.none()
+  })
+
+/** @internal */
+export const realPath = (tx: E.Transaction, input: M.Path): Result.Result<BytePath.BytePath, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    const route = yield* tx.targetResult(input)
+    const components: Array<BytePath.BytePath> = []
+    let id = route.object.id
+    if (route.object.kind !== "directory") {
+      if (route.parent === undefined || route.binding === undefined) {
+        return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidResource({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "wrongKind" }))
+      }
+      components.push(route.binding.name)
+      id = route.parent.id
+    }
+    while (id !== tx.caller.policy.root) {
+      yield* tx.visitResult()
+      const directory = yield* tx.directoryResult(id)
+      if (directory.parent === undefined) {
+        return yield* Result.fail(new M.AccessDenied({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "confinement" }))
+      }
+      const parent = yield* tx.directoryResult(directory.parent)
+      const binding = yield* tx.findBindingResult(parent, id)
+      if (binding === undefined) {
+        return yield* Result.fail(new M.AccessDenied({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "confinement" }))
+      }
+      components.push(binding.name)
+      id = parent.id
+    }
+    const length = components.reduce((total, component) => total + BytePath.byteLength(component) + 1, 0) || 1
+    yield* tx.reserveResult(BigInt(length))
+    const bytes = new Uint8Array(length)
+    let offset = 0
+    for (let index = components.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
+      bytes[offset++] = CHAR_FORWARD_SLASH
+      const component = BytePath.toBytes(components[index])
+      bytes.set(component, offset)
+      offset += component.length
+    }
+    if (components.length === 0) bytes[0] = CHAR_FORWARD_SLASH
+    return Result.getOrThrow(BytePath.fromBytes(bytes))
+  })
+
+/** @internal */
+export const readFileObserved = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  target: M.Target
+): Result.Result<M.ObservedRead<Uint8Array>, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    const { object: node } = yield* tx.targetResult(target)
+    if (node.kind !== "file") {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidResource({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "wrongKind" }))
+    }
+    yield* tx.requireResult(node, E.READ_PERMISSION)
+    const length = BigInt(node.data.length)
+    if (length > tx.engine.runtime.limits.ioBytes) {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.LimitExceeded({ operation: tx.operation, domain: "io", stage: "reservation" }))
+    }
+    if (length > tx.engine.runtime.limits.fileBytes) {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.LimitExceeded({ operation: tx.operation, domain: "file", stage: "reservation" }))
+    }
+    yield* tx.reserveResult(length)
+    const value = node.data.slice()
+    const accessTimeBeforeRead = node.atime
+    yield* tx.touchResult(node.id, ["atime"])
+    return { value, object: tx.observation(yield* tx.getResult(node.id)), accessTimeBeforeRead }
+  })
+
+/** @internal */
+export const readFile = (tx: E.Transaction, target: M.Target): Result.Result<Uint8Array, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.map(readFileObserved(tx, target), (read) => read.value)
+
+/** @internal */
+export const readLinkObserved = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  target: M.EntryTarget | M.ObjectReference
+): Result.Result<M.ObservedRead<BytePath.BytePath>, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    const { object: node } = yield* tx.targetResult(target, false)
+    if (node.kind !== "symlink") {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidResource({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "wrongKind" }))
+    }
+    yield* tx.reserveResult(BigInt(BytePath.byteLength(node.target)))
+    const accessTimeBeforeRead = node.atime
+    yield* tx.touchResult(node.id, ["atime"])
+    return { value: node.target, object: tx.observation(yield* tx.getResult(node.id)), accessTimeBeforeRead }
+  })
+
+/** @internal */
+export const readLink = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  target: M.EntryTarget | M.ObjectReference
+): Result.Result<BytePath.BytePath, M.OperationError> => Result.map(readLinkObserved(tx, target), (read) => read.value)
+
+const listDirectory = (tx: E.Transaction, target: M.Target, permissions: number, touchAtime = true) =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    const { object: node } = yield* tx.targetResult(target)
+    if (node.kind !== "directory") {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidResource({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "wrongKind" }))
+    }
+    yield* tx.requireResult(node, permissions)
+    const entries = yield* tx.listBindingsResult(node)
+    yield* tx.reserveResult(entries.reduce((total, entry) => total + BigInt(BytePath.byteLength(entry.name)), zero))
+    if (touchAtime) yield* tx.touchResult(node.id, ["atime"])
+    const directory = tx.observation(yield* tx.getResult(node.id))
+    if (directory.kind !== "directory") {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidResource({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "wrongKind" }))
+    }
+    return { node, directory, entries }
+  })
+
+/** @internal */
+export const readDirectory = (tx: E.Transaction, target: M.Target): Result.Result<M.NameListing, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.map(listDirectory(tx, target, E.READ_PERMISSION), ({ directory, entries }) => ({
+    directory,
+    names: entries.map((entry) => entry.name)
+  }))
+
+/** @internal */
+export const readDirents = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  target: M.Target,
+  touchAtime = true
+): Result.Result<M.DirentListing, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    const { directory, entries } = yield* listDirectory(tx, target, E.READ_PERMISSION, touchAtime)
+    const children: Array<M.DirentListing["entries"][number]> = []
+    for (const entry of entries) {
+      const child = yield* tx.getResult(entry.object)
+      children.push({
+        name: entry.name,
+        kind: child.kind,
+        objectNumber: child.id,
+        reference: tx.engine.reference(child.id)
+      })
+    }
+    return { directory, entries: children }
+  })
+
+/** @internal */
+export const readDirectoryEntries = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  target: M.Target
+): Result.Result<M.EntryListing, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    const { node, directory, entries } = yield* listDirectory(tx, target, E.READ_PERMISSION | E.EXECUTE_PERMISSION)
+    const observed: Array<M.ListedEntry> = []
+    for (const entry of entries) {
+      observed.push({
+        name: entry.name,
+        binding: M.issueToken("binding", tx.engine.runtime.instanceNumber, node.id, entry.version),
+        object: tx.observation(yield* tx.getResult(entry.object))
+      })
+    }
+    return { directory, entries: observed }
+  })

+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// File writes and attributes
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+/** Resolves final symlinks without losing the explicit original entry condition. */
+const writable = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  target: M.Target,
+  options: M.WriteFileOptions
+) =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    if (M.isToken(target)) {
+      if (
+        options.conditions !== undefined || options.mode !== undefined || options.replaceFinalSymlink !== undefined ||
+        (options.create !== undefined && options.create !== "existing")
+      ) {
+        return yield* Result.fail(
+          new M.InvalidInput({ operation: tx.operation, field: "options", reason: "malformed" })
+        )
+      }
+      const { object: node } = yield* tx.targetResult(target)
+      yield* tx.requireResult(
+        node,
+        options.access === "readwrite" ? (E.READ_PERMISSION | E.WRITE_PERMISSION) : E.WRITE_PERMISSION
+      )
+      yield* tx.revisionResult(node, options)
+      if (node.kind !== "file") {
+        return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidResource({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "wrongKind" }))
+      }
+      return node
+    }
+    if ((typeof target === "string" || BytePath.isBytePath(target)) && options.conditions !== undefined) {
+      return yield* Result.fail(
+        new M.InvalidInput({ operation: tx.operation, field: "conditions", reason: "malformed" })
+      )
+    }
+    const state: E.ResolutionState = { follows: 0 }
+    const initial = yield* tx.slotResult(target, undefined, state)
+    let selected = initial
+    const create = options.create ?? "ifmissing"
+    if (create === "exclusive") {
+      yield* tx.authorizeCreateResult(initial.parent, options.mode, "file")
+      yield* tx.conditionsResult(initial.parent, initial.binding, options.conditions)
+      if (initial.binding !== undefined) {
+        return yield* Result.fail(new M.AlreadyExists({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "occupiedEntry" }))
+      }
+    } else {
+      selected = options.replaceFinalSymlink ? initial : yield* tx.followFinalSlotResult(initial, state)
+      if (
+        selected.binding !== undefined && options.replaceFinalSymlink &&
+        (yield* tx.getResult(selected.binding.object)).kind === "symlink"
+      ) {
+        const victim = yield* tx.getResult(selected.binding.object)
+        yield* tx.stickyResult(selected.parent, victim)
+        yield* tx.authorizeCreateResult(selected.parent, options.mode, "file")
+        yield* tx.conditionsResult(initial.parent, initial.binding, options.conditions)
+        yield* tx.revisionResult(victim, options)
+        yield* tx.removeResult(selected.parent, selected.binding)
+        return yield* createWritableFile(tx, selected, options.mode)
+      }
+      if (selected.binding !== undefined) {
+        const node = yield* tx.getResult(selected.binding.object)
+        yield* tx.requireResult(
+          node,
+          options.access === "readwrite" ? (E.READ_PERMISSION | E.WRITE_PERMISSION) : E.WRITE_PERMISSION
+        )
+        yield* tx.conditionsResult(initial.parent, initial.binding, options.conditions)
+        yield* tx.revisionResult(node, options)
+        if (node.kind !== "file") {
+          return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidResource({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "wrongKind" }))
+        }
+        return node
+      }
+      if (create === "existing") {
+        yield* tx.conditionsResult(initial.parent, initial.binding, options.conditions)
+        return yield* Result.fail(new M.NotFound({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "missingEntry" }))
+      }
+      yield* tx.authorizeCreateResult(selected.parent, options.mode, "file")
+      yield* tx.conditionsResult(initial.parent, initial.binding, options.conditions)
+    }
+    if (options.expectedRevision !== undefined) {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.ConditionFailed({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "objectRevision" }))
+    }
+    return yield* createWritableFile(tx, selected, options.mode)
+  })
+
+const createWritableFile = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  selected: { parent: E.DirectoryNode; name: BytePath.BytePath },
+  mode?: number
+) =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    const node = yield* tx.createResult("file", selected.parent, mode)
+    if (node.kind !== "file") {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidResource({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "wrongKind" }))
+    }
+    yield* tx.insertResult(selected.parent.id, selected.name, node.id)
+    return node
+  })
+
+/** @internal */
+export const writeFile = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  target: M.Target,
+  data: Uint8Array,
+  options?: M.WriteFileOptions
+) =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    yield* validate("writeFile", options)
+    const node = yield* writable(tx, target, options ?? {})
+    if (options?.finalMode !== undefined) yield* attributesFor(tx, node, { mode: options.finalMode })
+    if (BigInt(data.length) > tx.engine.runtime.limits.ioBytes) {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.LimitExceeded({ operation: tx.operation, domain: "io", stage: "reservation" }))
+    }
+    const placement = options?.placement ?? "replace"
+    const length = placement === "replace"
+      ? data.length
+      : placement === "start"
+      ? Math.max(node.data.length, data.length)
+      : node.data.length + data.length
+    yield* reserveFile(tx, BigInt(length))
+    if (placement === "replace" || data.length > 0) tx.recordUpdate(node.id)
+    if (data.length === 0 && (placement !== "replace" || node.data.length === 0)) return
+    const next = new Uint8Array(length)
+    if (placement !== "replace") next.set(node.data)
+    next.set(data, placement === "append" ? node.data.length : 0)
+    const edited = yield* tx.editResult(node.id)
+    if (edited.kind !== "file") {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidResource({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "wrongKind" }))
+    }
+    if (options?.finalMode === undefined) edited.mode &= ~E.SET_ID_BITS
+    edited.data = next
+    yield* tx.changedResult(node.id, ["mtime", "ctime"])
+  })
+
+/** @internal */
+export const truncate = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  target: M.Target,
+  length: ByteSize.Input,
+  options?: M.RevisionCondition
+): Result.Result<void, M.OperationError> =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    yield* validate("truncate", options)
+    const requested = yield* R.sizeResult(length, tx.operation, "length")
+    const { object: node } = yield* tx.targetResult(target)
+    if (node.kind !== "file") {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidResource({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "wrongKind" }))
+    }
+    yield* tx.requireResult(node, E.WRITE_PERMISSION)
+    yield* tx.revisionResult(node, options)
+    const size = yield* reserveFile(tx, requested)
+    tx.recordUpdate(node.id)
+    if (requested === BigInt(node.data.length) && (node.mode & E.SET_ID_BITS) === 0) return
+    const data = new Uint8Array(size)
+    data.set(node.data.subarray(0, data.length))
+    const edited = yield* tx.editResult(node.id)
+    if (edited.kind !== "file") {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidResource({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "wrongKind" }))
+    }
+    edited.data = data
+    edited.mode &= ~E.SET_ID_BITS
+    yield* tx.changedResult(node.id, ["mtime", "ctime"])
+  })
+
+/** @internal */
+export const validateAttributes = (
+  attributes: M.Attributes,
+  operation: string
+) =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    yield* E.checkOptionsResult(attributes, attributeFields, operation)
+    if (attributes === undefined) {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "attributes", reason: "malformed" }))
+    }
+    if (attributes.size !== undefined) yield* R.sizeResult(attributes.size, operation, "size")
+    if (attributes.mode !== undefined) yield* E.modeResult(attributes.mode, operation)
+    if (attributes.uid !== undefined) yield* E.identityResult(attributes.uid, operation, "uid")
+    if (attributes.gid !== undefined) yield* E.identityResult(attributes.gid, operation, "gid")
+    if (attributes.atime !== undefined && attributes.atime !== "now" && !isUnixNano(attributes.atime)) {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "atime", reason: "malformed" }))
+    }
+    if (attributes.mtime !== undefined && attributes.mtime !== "now" && !isUnixNano(attributes.mtime)) {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "mtime", reason: "malformed" }))
+    }
+  })
+
+/**
+ * Authorizes all requested fields against the same prestate. Also used by retained handles.
+ *
+ * @internal
+ */
+export const attributesFor = (
+  tx: E.Transaction,
+  node: E.Node,
+  attributes: M.Attributes,
+  options?: M.RevisionCondition,
+  writeAccess?: boolean
+) =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    yield* validateAttributes(attributes, tx.operation)
+    const requested = attributes.size === undefined
+      ? undefined
+      : yield* R.sizeResult(attributes.size, tx.operation, "size")
+    if (requested !== undefined && node.kind !== "file") {
+      return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidResource({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "wrongKind" }))
+    }
+    if (attributes.mode !== undefined) {
+      yield* tx.ownsResult(node)
+      if (
+        node.kind === "directory" && (attributes.mode & E.SET_GID_BIT) !== 0 && (node.mode & E.SET_GID_BIT) === 0 &&
+        !tx.caller.policy.privileged && node.gid !== tx.caller.policy.gid && !tx.caller.policy.groups.includes(node.gid)
+      ) return yield* Result.fail(new M.AccessDenied({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "ownership" }))
+    }
+    if (attributes.uid !== undefined && !tx.caller.policy.privileged) {
+      yield* tx.ownsResult(node)
+      if (attributes.uid !== node.uid) {
+        return yield* Result.fail(new M.AccessDenied({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "ownership" }))
+      }
+    }
+    if (attributes.gid !== undefined) {
+      yield* tx.ownsResult(node)
+      if (
+        !tx.caller.policy.privileged && attributes.gid !== tx.caller.policy.gid &&
+        !tx.caller.policy.groups.includes(attributes.gid)
+      ) return yield* Result.fail(new M.AccessDenied({ operation: tx.operation, reason: "ownership" }))
+    }
+    if (attributes.atime !== undefined || attributes.mtime !== undefined) {
+      if (
+        attributes.atime === "now" && attributes.mtime === "now" &&
+        !tx.caller.policy.privileged && tx.caller.policy.uid !== node.uid
+      ) yield* tx.requireResult(node, E.WRITE_PERMISSION)
+      else yield* tx.ownsResult(node)
+    }
+    if (requested !== undefined) {
+      // Handles supply their open-time grant; path and reference updates check current permissions.
+      if (writeAccess === false) {

+      this.size++
+      this.changes.set(name, undefined)
+      this.appended.set(name, binding)
+    } else if (this.appended.has(name)) this.appended.set(name, binding)
+    else this.changes.set(name, binding)
+  }
+  delete(name: string): boolean {
+    if (this.get(name) === undefined) return false
+    this.size--
+    this.appended.delete(name)
+    this.changes.set(name, undefined)
+    return true
+  }
+  *entries(): IterableIterator<[string, Binding]> {
+    for (const [name, binding] of this.base.entries()) {
+      if (!this.changes.has(name)) yield [name, binding]
+      else {
+        const replacement = this.changes.get(name)
+        if (replacement !== undefined) yield [name, replacement]
+      }
+    }
+    yield* this.appended.entries()
+  }
+  *values(): IterableIterator<Binding> {
+    for (const [, binding] of this.entries()) yield binding
+  }
+  publish(): DirectoryEntries {
+    for (const [name, binding] of this.changes) {
+      if (binding === undefined) this.base.delete(name)
+      else this.base.set(name, binding)
+    }
+    for (const [name, binding] of this.appended) this.base.set(name, binding)
+    return this.base
+  }
+}

+interface Base {

+const weakSweep = (ref: WeakRef<Engine>) => () => ref.deref()?.sweep()

+interface EntrySlot {

+export interface FileState {

+
+export const owners = new WeakMap<M.Owner, Engine>()
+const storageEngine = (owner: M.Owner) => {
+  const engine = owners.get(owner)
+  if (!engine) throw new Error("Unknown preview owner")
+  return engine
+}
+
+// Core v1 persists its own revision numbers. Preview observation tokens are session-local.
+export const resumeAllocator = (owner: M.Owner, nextObject: bigint) => {
+  const engine = storageEngine(owner)
+
+  if (nextObject < engine.nextObject) throw new Error("Invalid restored allocator")
+  engine.nextObject = nextObject
+
+  return (ino: bigint) => engine.reference(ino)
+}
+
+export const installStorage = (
+  owner: M.Owner,
+  offer: NonNullable<Engine["offer"]>,
+  frozen: () => boolean
+) => {
+  const engine = storageEngine(owner)
+  if (engine.offer) throw new Error("Storage already installed")
+  if (engine.runtime.limits.synchronous) throw new Error("Storage requires synchronous operations to be disabled")
+  const gate = Semaphore.makeUnsafe(1)
+  engine.offer = offer
+  engine.runtime.storageUnavailable = frozen
+  engine.runtime.storageTurn = <A, E, R>(effect: Effect.Effect<A, E, R>) => gate.withPermit(effect)
+
+  return gate.withPermit(Effect.void)
+}

+export const callers = new WeakMap<M.VirtualFileSystem, Caller>()

+interface DirectoryHandleState {
+  readonly caller: Caller
+  readonly resource: R.Resource
+  readonly id: bigint

+export const registerDirectoryHandle = (
+  value: M.DirectoryHandle | M.SyncDirectoryHandle,
+  state: DirectoryHandleState
+) => {
+  directoryHandles.set(value, state)
+}

+export const directoryHandleState = (candidate: unknown) =>
+  typeof candidate === "object" && candidate !== null ? directoryHandles.get(candidate) : undefined
+
+// NOTE: Registration records issued views. Membership proves identity, while the
+// retrieved resource and runtime are still checked before the handle is used.
+export const isDirectoryHandle = (candidate: unknown): candidate is M.DirectoryHandle | M.SyncDirectoryHandle =>
+  directoryHandleState(candidate) !== undefined

+// Input validation and path values
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+const BooleanOptions = Schema.Record(Schema.String, Schema.Unknown)
+
+const isOptions = Schema.is(BooleanOptions)
+const isString = Schema.is(Schema.String)
+const isName = Schema.is(M.Name)
+const isBigInt = Schema.is(Schema.BigInt)
+
+/** @internal */
+export const checkOptionsResult = (
+  input: unknown,
+  allowed: ReadonlyArray<string>,
+  operation: string
+) => {
+  if (input === undefined) return Result.succeed(undefined)
+  if (!isOptions(input)) return Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "options", reason: "malformed" }))
+  for (const key of Object.keys(input)) {
+    if (!allowed.includes(key)) {
+      return Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: key, reason: "excessField" }))
+    }
+  }
+  return Result.succeed(input)
+}
+
+/** @internal */
+export const identityResult = (
+  input: unknown,
+  operation: string,
+  field: string
+) =>
+  M.isIdentity(input)
+    ? Result.succeed(input)
+    : Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field, reason: "range" }))
+
+/** @internal */
+export const groupInheritanceResult = (input: unknown, operation: string) =>
+  input === undefined || input === "setgid" || input === "parent"
+    ? Result.succeed<"setgid" | "parent">(input ?? "setgid")
+    : Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "groupInheritance", reason: "malformed" }))
+
+/** @internal */
+export const accessTimeResult = (input: unknown, operation: string) =>
+  input === undefined || input === "strict" || input === "relatime"
+    ? Result.succeed<"strict" | "relatime">(input ?? "strict")
+    : Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "accessTime", reason: "malformed" }))
+
+/** @internal */
+export const modeResult = (
+  input: unknown,
+  operation: string
+) => {
+  if (!M.isPermissionMode(input)) {
+    return Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "mode", reason: "unsupportedBits" }))
+  }
+  return Result.succeed(input)
+}
+
+/** @internal */
+export const bufferLengthResult = (input: Uint8Array, operation: string) =>
+  Result.mapError(
+    Bytes.byteLength(input),
+    () => new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "data", reason: "invalidBuffer" })
+  )
+
+/** @internal */
+export const pathLengthResult = (path: M.Path, operation: string) => {
+  if (BytePath.isBytePath(path)) return Result.succeed(BytePath.byteLength(path))
+  if (!isString(path)) return Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "path", reason: "malformed" }))
+  let total = 0
+  for (let i = 0; i < path.length; i++) {
+    const unit = path.charCodeAt(i)
+    if (unit === 0) return Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "path", reason: "malformed" }))
+    if (unit < 128) total++
+    else if (unit < 2048) total += 2
+    else if (unit >= 0xd800 && unit <= 0xdbff) {
+      const low = path.charCodeAt(++i)
+      if (!(low >= 0xdc00 && low <= 0xdfff)) {
+        return Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "path", reason: "malformed" }))
+      }
+      total += 4
+    } else if (unit >= 0xdc00 && unit <= 0xdfff) {
+      return Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "path", reason: "malformed" }))
+    } else total += 3
+  }
+  return Result.succeed(total)
+}
+
+/** @internal */
+export const pathValueResult = (
+  path: M.Path,
+  operation: string
+) => {
+  if (BytePath.isBytePath(path)) return Result.succeed(path)
+  return Result.mapError(
+    BytePath.fromString(path),
+    () => new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "path", reason: "malformed" })
+  )
+}
+
+export const key = (name: BytePath.BytePath) => Hex.encode(BytePath.toBytes(name))
+const isDot = (bytes: Uint8Array) => bytes.length === 1 && bytes[0] === CHAR_DOT
+const isDotDot = (bytes: Uint8Array) => bytes.length === 2 && bytes[0] === CHAR_DOT && bytes[1] === CHAR_DOT
+
+/** @internal */
+export const nameValueResult = (input: M.Path, operation: string) =>
+  Result.gen(function*() {
+    const name = yield* pathValueResult(input, operation)
+    if (!isName(name)) return yield* Result.fail(new M.InvalidInput({ operation, field: "name", reason: "malformed" }))
+    return name
+  })
+
+export const asciiPath = (path: string) => Result.getOrThrow(BytePath.fromString(path))
+
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Filesystem state
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+export class Engine {
+  offer?: (
+    nodes: ReadonlyMap<bigint, Node>,
+    changed: ReadonlySet<bigint>,
+    nextObject: bigint,
+    operation: string
+  ) => R.StorageOffer
+
+  offerState(
+    changes: ReadonlyMap<bigint, Node>,
+    removed: ReadonlyArray<bigint>,
+    nextObject: bigint,
+    operation: string,
+    acquiringFile = false
+  ) {
+    if (!this.offer) return undefined
+    const changed = new Set<bigint>()
+    for (const [id, node] of changes) {
+      const prior = this.nodes.get(id)
+      // A read can refresh atime without advancing the object's revision.
+      if (!prior || prior.revision !== node.revision || prior.atime !== node.atime) changed.add(id)
+    }
+    if (!acquiringFile && changed.size === 0 && removed.length === 0 && nextObject === this.nextObject) return undefined
+    const nodes = new Map(this.nodes)
+    for (const [id, node] of changes) nodes.set(id, node)
+    for (const id of removed) nodes.delete(id)
+    return this.offer(nodes, changed, nextObject, operation)
+  }
+
+  readonly runtime: R.Runtime
+  readonly inputLimits: Readonly<Pick<M.Limits, "ioBytes" | "pathBytes">>
+  readonly root: bigint
+  readonly listeners = new Set<(batch: ReadonlyArray<M.CommittedMutation>) => void>()
+  readonly nodes = new Map<bigint, Node>()
+  readonly pins = new Map<bigint, number>()
+  private readonly releaseCandidates = new Set<bigint>()
+  entryCount = 0
+  contentBytes = BigInt("0")
+  nextObject = BigInt("2")
+  nextBinding = BigInt("1")
+
+  readonly accessTime: "strict" | "relatime"
+  readonly groupInheritance: "setgid" | "parent"
+
+  constructor(
+    runtime: R.Runtime,
+    root: { readonly uid: number; readonly gid: number; readonly mode: number },
+    rootId = BigInt("1"),
+    accessTime: "strict" | "relatime" = "strict",
+    groupInheritance: "setgid" | "parent" = "setgid"
+  ) {
+    this.runtime = runtime
+    this.accessTime = accessTime
+    this.groupInheritance = groupInheritance
+    this.inputLimits = Object.freeze({ ioBytes: runtime.limits.ioBytes, pathBytes: runtime.limits.pathBytes })
+    this.root = rootId
+    this.nextObject = rootId + BigInt("1")
+    const now = this.now()
+    this.nodes.set(this.root, {
+      ...root,
+      id: this.root,
+      kind: "directory",
+      nlink: BigInt("2"),
+      entries: new Map(),
+      parent: undefined,
+      namespace: BigInt("1"),
+      revision: BigInt("1"),
+      atime: now,
+      mtime: now,
+      ctime: now,
+      birthtime: now
+    })
+    runtime.onRelease = weakSweep(new WeakRef(this))
+  }
+
+  now() {
+    const value = this.runtime.clock.currentTimeNanosUnsafe()
+    if (!isBigInt(value)) throw new TypeError("Clock.currentTimeNanosUnsafe must return bigint")
+    return DateTime.unixNanoFromNanoseconds(value)
+  }
+
+  pin(id: bigint) {
+    this.pins.set(id, (this.pins.get(id) ?? 0) + 1)
+  }
+
+  unpin(id: bigint): void {
+    const n = this.pins.get(id)
+    if (n === undefined) return
+    if (n === 1) {
+      this.pins.delete(id)
+      this.releaseCandidates.add(id)
+    } else this.pins.set(id, n - 1)
+  }
+  *releasedObjects(): IterableIterator<Node> {
+    for (const id of this.releaseCandidates) {
+      const node = this.nodes.get(id)
+      if (node !== undefined && node.nlink === BigInt("0") && !this.pins.has(id)) yield node
+    }
+  }
+  reclaim(id: bigint): void {
+    const node = this.nodes.get(id)
+    if (node !== undefined && node.nlink === BigInt("0") && !this.pins.has(id)) {
+      this.nodes.delete(id)
+      if (node.kind === "directory") this.entryCount -= node.entries.size
+      else {this.contentBytes -= node.kind === "file"
+          ? BigInt(node.data.length)
+          : BigInt(BytePath.byteLength(node.target))}
+    }
+    this.releaseCandidates.delete(id)
+  }
+  sweep(): void {
+    for (const id of this.releaseCandidates) this.reclaim(id)
+  }
+  publishNode(node: Node): void {
+    // Entry maps change only during publication. Snapshots must copy entries rather than retain this map.
+    if (node.kind === "directory" && node.entries instanceof DirectoryDraft) node.entries = node.entries.publish()
+    this.nodes.set(node.id, node)
+    if (node.nlink === BigInt("0")) this.releaseCandidates.add(node.id)
+  }
+  initializeCapacity(): void {
+    const usage = this.usage()
+    this.entryCount = usage.entries
+    this.contentBytes = usage.contentBytes
+  }
+  retainResult(policy: Policy, resource: R.Resource) {
+    return this.retainObjectsResult(resource, [policy.root, policy.cwd, ...policy.boundaries])
+  }
+
+  retainObjectsResult(resource: R.Resource, ids: Iterable<bigint>) {
+    const retained = new Set(ids)
+    return Result.map(
+      resource.releaseWithResult(() => {
+        for (const id of retained) this.unpin(id)
+      }),
+      () => {
+        for (const id of retained) this.pin(id)
+        if (retained.size > 0 && !(retained.size === 1 && retained.has(this.root))) {
+          // Storage can be installed after acquisition. Inspect the pins when close holds the storage turn.
+          resource.cleanupOffer = () => {
+            if (!this.offer || this.runtime.storageUnavailable?.()) return undefined
+            const removed: Array<bigint> = []
+            for (const id of retained) {
+              if (this.pins.get(id) === 1 && this.nodes.get(id)?.nlink === BigInt("0")) removed.push(id)
+            }
+            if (removed.length === 0) return undefined
+            return this.offerState(new Map(), removed, this.nextObject, "close")
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    )
+  }
+
+  usage() {
+    let content = BigInt("0")
+    let entries = 0
+    let retained = 0
+    let retainedContent = BigInt("0")
+    for (const node of this.nodes.values()) {
+      const bytes = node.kind === "file"
+        ? BigInt(node.data.length)
+        : node.kind === "symlink"
+        ? BigInt(BytePath.byteLength(node.target))
+        : BigInt("0")
+      content += bytes
+      if (node.kind === "directory") entries += node.entries.size
+      if (node.nlink === BigInt("0")) {
+        retained++
+        retainedContent += bytes
+      }
+    }
+    return {
+      liveObjects: this.nodes.size,
+      entries,
+      contentBytes: ByteSize.bytes(content),
+      unreachableRetainedObjects: retained,
+      unreachableRetainedContentBytes: ByteSize.bytes(retainedContent),
+      callers: this.runtime.callers,
+      handles: this.runtime.handles,
+      operations: this.runtime.ordinary,
+      reservedTransientBytes: ByteSize.bytes(this.runtime.payload)
+    }
+  }
+
+  metadata(node: Node) {
+    return {
+      kind: node.kind,
+      objectNumber: node.id,
+      uid: node.uid,
+      gid: node.gid,
+      mode: node.mode,
+      nlink: node.nlink,
+      size: ByteSize.bytes(
+        node.kind === "file" ? node.data.length : node.kind === "symlink" ? BytePath.byteLength(node.target) : 0
+      ),
+      atime: node.atime,
+      mtime: node.mtime,
+      ctime: node.ctime,
+      birthtime: node.birthtime
+    }
+  }
+
+  reference(id: bigint) {
+    return M.issueToken("object", this.runtime.instanceNumber, id, BigInt("0"))
+  }
+
+  observation(node: Node): M.ObjectObservation {
+    const common = {
+      reference: this.reference(node.id),
+      revision: M.issueToken("revision", this.runtime.instanceNumber, node.id, node.revision)
+    }
+    const metadata = this.metadata(node)
+    if (node.kind === "directory") {
+      return {
+        ...common,
+        kind: "directory",
+        metadata: { ...metadata, kind: "directory" },
+        namespaceRevision: M.issueToken("namespace", this.runtime.instanceNumber, node.id, node.namespace)
+      }
+    }
+    if (node.kind === "file") return { ...common, kind: "file", metadata: { ...metadata, kind: "file" } }
+    return { ...common, kind: "symlink", metadata: { ...metadata, kind: "symlink" } }
+  }
+}
+
